breakdown.description: The domain height and initial water column are oriented along the Y-axis, but the gravity vector is set to the -Z direction, which will not cause the dam to break downwards.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not address the gravity vector at all. It discusses Courant number settings in controlDict, which is completely unrelated to the inconsistency about the gravity vector direction. The gravity vector should have been corrected from (0 0 -9.81) to (0 -9.81 0) to match the Y-axis orientation of the domain height, but this was not addressed.
